description: List the installable versions (releases) of a modpack, server variant, or the game itself, in the order the panel's installer lists them. Get the file_id from search_game_files. Pass the chosen release_id, with the same file_id, to create_instance.

file_id.description: File id from search_game_files (a result's file_id, or base_game.file_id for the game itself).

game_version.description: Only return releases built for this game version, e.g. "1.21.1".

limit.description: How many releases to return. Defaults to 25, at most 100.

version.description: Only return releases whose version contains this text, e.g. "1.43.1".

name: list_file_releases
title: List Versions
